du_cpu_overload.service_impact: DL/UL throughput degradation, late HARQ responses, increased scheduling latency
du_cpu_overload.probable_cause: CPU contention from competing workloads, insufficient CPU isolation, missing RT kernel tuning
du_cpu_overload.reaction_procedure: Check CPU affinity, identify competing processes, verify RT kernel and TuneD profile, adjust cgroup limits

du_timing_failure.service_impact: Cell outage, UE disconnections, HARQ failures
du_timing_failure.probable_cause: PTP grandmaster unreachable, NIC timestamping disabled, ptp4l process crashed
du_timing_failure.reaction_procedure: Check ptp4l status, verify grandmaster connectivity, restart PTP daemon, check NIC hardware timestamping

du_throughput_drop.service_impact: Reduced user throughput, SLA breach risk
du_throughput_drop.probable_cause: CPU overload, interference, UE channel degradation, PRB exhaustion
du_throughput_drop.reaction_procedure: Check CQI trends, verify CPU load, check for interference, review PRB utilization

amf_gnb_disconnect.service_impact: gNB isolated from core, all UEs on cell lose service
amf_gnb_disconnect.probable_cause: Network partition, SCTP path failure, AMF crash, firewall rule change
amf_gnb_disconnect.reaction_procedure: Check SCTP connectivity, verify network path, check AMF pod status, review recent config changes

upf_pfcp_loss.service_impact: No new PDU sessions, existing sessions may timeout
upf_pfcp_loss.probable_cause: SMF-UPF network path broken, UPF crash, PFCP heartbeat timeout
upf_pfcp_loss.reaction_procedure: Verify SMF-UPF connectivity, check UPF pod status, restart UPF if needed, verify PFCP re-association

nf_crashloop.service_impact: Degraded core network, dependent NFs may fail
nf_crashloop.probable_cause: OOM kill, config error, dependency unavailable, image pull failure
nf_crashloop.reaction_procedure: Check pod events, review logs for crash reason, verify resource limits, check dependencies

sbi_mesh_failure.probable_cause: SCP caching stale endpoints, NRF registration expired, DNS resolution failure
sbi_mesh_failure.reaction_procedure: Restart SCP to clear cache, verify NRF registrations, check DNS resolution

network_partition.service_impact: RAN isolated from core, complete service outage for affected cells
network_partition.probable_cause: VPN tunnel down, routing change, firewall rule, physical link failure
network_partition.reaction_procedure: Check VPN tunnel status, verify routing tables, test connectivity, check physical links

ptp_drift.service_impact: TDD scheduling failure, cell degradation or outage
ptp_drift.probable_cause: Grandmaster unreachable, NIC timestamping failure, kernel not RT-capable
ptp_drift.reaction_procedure: Check ptp4l offset, verify grandmaster, restart PTP daemon, verify RT kernel

amf_registration_failure.service_impact: UEs cannot register, new subscribers rejected
amf_registration_failure.probable_cause: AUSF/UDM/UDR auth chain broken, MongoDB down, subscriber not provisioned
amf_registration_failure.reaction_procedure: Check auth chain: AUSF→UDM→UDR→MongoDB. Verify subscriber exists.

amf_auth_rejection.probable_cause: Subscriber credentials mismatch, AUSF error, UDR subscription expired
amf_auth_rejection.reaction_procedure: Check subscriber K/OPC in MongoDB, verify AUSF/UDM logs

smf_pfcp_failure.probable_cause: UPF unreachable, PFCP association lost, cross-CNI routing broken
smf_pfcp_failure.reaction_procedure: Check SMF→UPF PFCP, verify UPF pod, check cross-CNI routing

smf_session_drop.probable_cause: UPF restart, PFCP re-association, PCF policy error
smf_session_drop.reaction_procedure: Check SMF/UPF logs, verify PFCP, check PCF policy errors

upf_no_traffic.probable_cause: GTP tunnel down, N3 interface issue, no active sessions
upf_no_traffic.reaction_procedure: Check UPF sessions, verify GTP tunnel, check N3 interface
